response.sql:
WITH matched_telescopes AS (
  SELECT 
    t.telescregistry,
    t.bandusagepct,
    o.observstation,
    o.lunarstage
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
station_phase_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    lunarstage,
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg
  FROM matched_telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation
),
phase_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    lunarstage,
    AVG(station_avg) as avg_bandwidth
  FROM station_phase_avg
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
phase_info AS (
  SELECT 
    lunarstage,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM matched_telescopes
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM matched_telescopes
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(pi.lunarstage, 'Missing') as phase,
  pa.avg_bandwidth,
  pi.count,
  CAST(pi.count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as share
FROM phase_info pi
LEFT JOIN phase_avg pa ON (pi.lunarstage = pa.lunarstage OR (pi.lunarstage IS NULL AND pa.lunarstage IS NULL))
CROSS JOIN total_count tc
ORDER BY CASE WHEN pi.lunarstage IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, pi.lunarstage;

assumptions.assumption: "averaging per station first and then across stations" means: for each (phase, station) combination, calculate the mean bandwidth; then for each phase, take the mean of those station-level means. This hierarchical averaging differs from a flat mean across all telescopes.

alternatives.interpretation: The average is computed directly per phase without intermediate station-level grouping (i.e., a simple mean of all bandwidths for each phase, ignoring the "per station first" instruction).
